blocks.text: Coming off a hard-fought bronze finish in the Premier Volleyball League (PVL) Invitational Conference 2026, the PLDT High Speed Hitters are definitely not resting on their laurels – channeling the momentum from their recent success into immediate preparation for this new milestone 10th season. At the heart of PLDT’s sustained rise are defensive anchor Kath Arado and explosive outside hitter Savi Davison – two decorated stars whose synergy continues to set the benchmark for the franchise. With 12 individual PVL awards combined, the duo has anchored both ends of the floor. Arado’s elite back-row defense and floor coverage consistently give the […]...
